explain_task.question: Using the original and revised models together, explain precisely why the objective rises from 57.0 to 59.666666666666664. Your answer must name the exact revised code additions (`z1_high`, `z2_high`, `cDispLow`, `cDispHigh`, and the constraints `Process1TimeMode`, `Process2TimeMode`, `MutualExclusionHighMode`, `LowDisposalCap`) and trace each one back to the business brief terms and the exact `general_parameters.csv` fields such as `available_time_process_1_high`, `available_time_process_2_high`, `threshold_c`, and `disposal_cost_per_unit_c_high`. Also diagnose which revised constraints are binding in the integer optimum versus the LP relaxation, interpret the reported dual/shadow prices and slacks for at least `MutualExclusionHighMode` and `LowDisposalCap`, and explain why you cannot linearly extrapolate those dual values to predict the MILP objective if both stages were allowed high-throughput or if disposal exceeded `threshold_c` further.
